CPDV.displayText: My heart has become disturbed within me, and the dread of death has fallen over me.

verses.context: Betrayed by a close friend, David describes his heart pounding with anguish and fear of death.

KJV.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
KJV.displayText: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

BSB.text: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
BSB.displayText: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.

CPDV.text: Cease from wrath and leave behind rage. Do not choose to imitate the malicious.
CPDV.displayText: Cease from wrath and leave behind rage. Do not choose to imitate the malicious.

verses.context: In a psalm about not envying people who get ahead by doing wrong, David urges his readers to let go of anger and stop fretting.

KJV.text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
KJV.displayText: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

BSB.text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
BSB.displayText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

CPDV.text: And may the Lord direct your hearts, in the charity of God and with the patience of Christ.
CPDV.displayText: And may the Lord direct your hearts, in the charity of God and with the patience of Christ.

verses.context: Near the end of his second letter to the Thessalonians, Paul prays that the Lord would guide their hearts into God's love and Christ's endurance.

KJV.text: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
KJV.displayText: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

BSB.text: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
BSB.displayText: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”

CPDV.text: And yet, even when you suffer something for the sake of justice, you are blessed. So then, do not be afraid with their fear, and do not be disturbed.
CPDV.displayText: And yet, even when you suffer something for the sake of justice, you are blessed. So then, do not be afraid with their fear, and do not be disturbed.

verses.context: Writing to believers facing hostility for their faith, Peter says those who suffer for doing right are blessed and need not be shaken.
